adjustments.requirement: Identify financing interest actually included in CFO, with borrowing/lease overlap resolved. Expense and principal are not cash-interest substitutes.
Identify excluded investment/nonoperating cash remaining in CFO. Do not subtract accrual gains already reversed by the cash-flow reconciliation.
Specify a historical unlevered operating-tax treatment and its financing/nonoperating tax effects. Cash taxes, provision and reported ETR are different populations.
Retain compensation as an expense consistently with the forecast. Review reversal of the actual CFO SBC add-back, not a second deduction of the expense proxy.
Identify non-overlapping additions to financed operating assets. Combined operating/finance additions and liability changes are not finance-investment substitutes.
Review cash PP&E, capitalized interest, capital-creditor settlements and acquisitions against the forecast investment/growth perimeter; count each once.

assumptions: Annual consolidated reported ETR proxies the tax effect of the net nonoperating/financing adjustment, not a separately reported operating cash-tax rate.
Net nonoperating accrual income plus identified pure nonoperating CFO reversals proxies remaining nonoperating cash. Accrual/cash timing and tax attribution are not fully reconciled.
Mixed Other and working-capital lines stay in CFO; unallocated nonoperating/tax/SBC effects are not separately estimated. This omission can be material and is not a reported zero.
Original cash PP&E is retained without a separate capitalized-interest/capital-creditor/acquisition adjustment. This is an omission assumption, not exhaustive investment coverage.
Reversing the actual CFO SBC add-back retains the compensation cost already in earnings; do not deduct the expense proxy again.
No new D&A add-back, book NWC reconstruction, lease principal deduction or separate overlapping interest add-back.

finance_estimate_basis.assumption: Later investment mix approximates FY2021. Ex-post backcast; not contemporaneous information or a reported amount.
finance_estimate_basis.formula: FY2021 cash PP&E * median FY2022-FY2025 finance additions / cash PP&E ratio
